_meta.description: AGG_ZSCORE per region on customers.pulse income beside the region mean. Its scalar is the mean of the region's row z-scores, 0 by construction (each region standardises against its own mean and standard deviation); the usable figures are the components: pop_mean, pop_stddev and the last row's target_value and zscore. For a per-row z-score use ATTR_ZSCORE. Buffered.
_meta.name: zscore_grouped
